conditions.today: 6 AM—Rise and shine! The big-mountain beach party continues into the first weekend of spring, turning Rendezvous Mountain into a fascinating plaything. Photons will fall through partly cloudy skies before refracting from the landscape and landing squarely in the back of your eyes. Take it all in, but remember to dress fairly slim, because temperatures will zoom well into the 40s at the summit as they approach the mid-60s down in Teton Village. Light-to-moderate west winds will do what they can to keep you cool as they breeze through in the 10 to 30 mph range. Despite the bright sunlight, your pupils will over-dilate, attempting to record the extraordinary sight when you roll the next knoll and your satiated soul takes flight. -Lege
conditions.yesterday: 6 AM—Don't spend your day doom-scrolling the latest TikToks; come celebrate with the sun as we cross the vernal equinox. The first official day of spring 2026 will feature deep blue skies and laser-like sun-sations, sending your daydreaming mind to fantastical destinations. Slather on the sunscreen and lose another layer, because temperature records may fall today. Expect highs at the summit that push into the mid-40s as Teton Village once again flirts with the 70-degree mark. A welcome west wind will be breezing through in the neighborhood of 5 to 20 mph. Situated halfway between summer's sweltering heat and the brisk snap of winter, we get to enjoy a taste of both in this magical place. Just feel the rising heat on your cheeks and blast some icy crystals in your face. -Lege
